sources.publisher: UK Department of Health and Social Care

publisher: PSIP (trading name of BN Solutions Limited)

vendor_reported_coverage.reason_for_exclusions: Publisher reports loading errors in published spending files and withholds affected bodies from headline spend and transaction totals.
vendor_reported_coverage.scope: Publisher's own coverage and classification, not independently audited market-wide counts, payment completeness, or customer demand. Older cached 2026-11-02 snapshot has different denominators; not combined.

vendor_reported_product.classification: Publisher reports classifying award values and excluding unknown values from totals.
vendor_reported_product.commercial_status: Advertised prices and features only; no verified subscriber counts, paid conversion, revenue or external QA purchasing.

selected_official_payer_rows.selection: Two explicitly labeled grant-in-aid rows and five differently classified expense lines sharing one transaction number, selected for semantics illustration; not a representative sample or full monthly report.

rows.expense_type: Rent of Land & Buildings (non-PFI operating lease)

selected_official_payer_rows.interpretation: Official payer-reported funding transfers are not supplier purchases. Public-body recipient alone does not identify a grant; the DWP lines are reported operating expense categories. A transaction number can identify multiple accounting lines, so first-row-only deduplication would discard reported amounts. This is not a legal procurement classification, bank reconciliation, full report total, or independent verification of PSIP's aggregate figures.

commercial_implication: Concrete evidence of recurring data classification, source freshness and ingestion-quality work at a commercial procurement-intelligence provider. Independent QA may be a useful B2B hypothesis, but the provider already has internal validation and no external purchasing intent is evidenced. Do not build a broad UK spend platform or infer a market size from these figures.
